targets.authors: Gethin, A., Martínez-Toledano, C., and Piketty, T.
targets.title: Brahmin Left versus Merchant Right: Changing Political Cleavages in 21 Western Democracies, 1948–2020.
targets.evidence_quote: In this report we have presented the results from a replication of Gethin, Martínez-Toledano and Piketty (GMP, 2022). We have tested the computational reproducibility and robustness replicability of the GMP main results.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: With the exception of a very minor issue in the codes, we are able to run the full replication package provided by the authors, and we find the GMP results to be fully reproducible.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Naturally, our robustness replications change the results somewhat, but our overall conclusion is that the main GMP results are replicable and robust to our checks.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original data and code re-analysis. Correcting a minor execution problem yielded original results; alternative specifications and removed manual adjustments leave the substantive result robust by authors’ explicit assessment.

reasoning: No fresh sample collected. The population weights are an alternative specification of original voting data. Both reproduction axes established independently; original article DOI is not printed in the reference, so left empty.
